create_vector2: create a 2D sympy Matrix vector with x and y components using Vector2
create_vector3: create a 3D sympy Matrix vector with x, y, z components using Vector3
compute_dot_product: compute the dot product of two sympy Matrix vectors using the dot function
compute_squared_norm: compute the squared norm of a sympy Matrix vector using squared_norm
project_homogeneous_vector: project a homogeneous vector by dividing all but the last component by the last using proj
